newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean won/dollar market closed until Monday.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean won/dollar market closed until Monday.

text.p: The South Korean foreign exchange market is closed from Thursday for the Chusok holidays and will reopen on Monday, dealers said.
The won closed on Wednesday at 821.00 after opening at 820.60. It moved in a range from 820.40 to 822.00.
Dealers forecast the 822 won mark would be a strong resistance level and they refrained from actively buying dollars around that level.
Monday's mid-rate is expected to be pegged at 821.10 against Wednesday's 820.60.
